entries.text: Every owner with more than 25% of the business needs their own identity check, and the offer shouldn’t show until they’ve all passed. Can we show who’s still outstanding?
I’ll add an owners step after the business details, with each owner’s check as a row, and hold the offer page behind it with a notice listing who’s still to do.
Prelude rendered every page and form in every state (42), and they all render.
